comments.content: [medium] The pluralization logic shows up repeatedly — pulling it into a shared helper function would remove the duplication.

[medium] Possible name collisions: registering only `prompt.name` as the slash command name could clash across multiple MCP servers or with built-in commands. Namespacing (e.g., `${serverName}:${prompt.name}`) or introducing a server-level parent command would prevent overrides/ambiguity in the CLI command registry.
[medium] The completion function may have a regex problem — substring(2) could misbehave when the input contains more than one dash. The mapping logic could also be simplified.

[medium] `discoverPrompts` saves `response.prompts` as-is. If that field is ever absent (depending on how the schema/SDK evolves), `undefined` would end up stored in the map, so consider normalizing to an empty array — e.g., `const prompts = response.prompts ?? []` — to keep the map's value type consistent.

[medium] Because `promptParams` is an object interpolated directly into a template literal, it renders as '[object Object]', which isn't useful when debugging. Either pass it through JSON.stringify() or log the object as a separate argument instead.
[low] Consider moving the `if (descLines)` assumption into an explicit validation step before this work begins.
